title: agx look variants
description:
Expose the three new AgX look variants (core commit b69c3f5)
in the clip editor's Tonemapping section, ClipEditorScreen.kt
DetailPanel (the tonemap Int mapping site — no new GradeK
fields, no GradeStore/SliderSteps changes):

- Row 1 stays Off / ACES / AgX. The AgX tab is selected for
  ANY tonemap >= 2 and re-tapping it while a variant is chosen
  keeps the variant (no snap-back to Punchy); choosing AgX from
  Off/ACES enters Punchy (2), the historical default.
- Row 2, 'AgX Look', renders ONLY while AgX is active (the same
  conditional-second-row pattern as the stabilization mode
  row): Punchy (2) / Golden (3) / Greyscale (4) / Base (5),
  segmented buttons on the same discrete settle path as row 1
  (immediate full-tier history step, not a drag).
- Look names stay untranslated in tr (upstream AgX look names,
  like ACES/AgX); the row label translates (en 'AgX Look',
  tr 'AgX Görünü
changed: feat: agx look variants golden greyscale base
feat: agx look chooser in editor panel
